newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti share trading bands widened.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti share trading bands widened.

text.p: Share trading bands for troubled Olivetti have been widened to 15 percent from 10 percent previously in order to try to allow the stock to open on the Milan bourse, the stock exchange council said.
Earlier in pre-bourse trade Olivetti was quoted at 620 lire (41 cents) per share compared with its previous price of 749 lire, set prior to suspension on Thursday and Friday.
The stock did not open with the rest of the bourse on Monday and the stock market council said the next opening time would be 1042 local time (0842 GMT) after pre-opening price fixing.
Traders said the 15 percent fluctuation limit meant Olivetti would have to open above 637 lire.
"So it's unlikely to open once again because it's being quoted at 620," a trader said. ($ = 1511 Italian Lire)
